```{r}
# Load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(corrplot)
library(GGally)
library(gridExtra)
library(reshape2)
library(data.table)
#install.packages("survival")
library(survival)
#install.packages("survminer")
library(survminer)
library(caret)
```

### pre processing

```{r}
# Load dataset
data <- fread("data/brca_metabric_clinical_data.tsv")
```

```{r}
# Check if Sample ID and Patient ID are identical
identical_ids <- identical(data$`Sample ID`, data$`Patient ID`)


# Check unique values in cancer type, Study ID, Sample Type, Number of Samples Per Patient
unique_cancer_types <- unique(data$`Cancer Type`)
unique_study_ids <- unique(data$`Study ID`)
unique_sample_types <- unique(data$`Sample Type`)
unique_numbers_of_samples_per_patient<-unique(data$`Number of Samples Per Patient`)


# If assumptions are true, remove redundant columns
if (identical_ids) {
  data <- subset(data, select = -`Sample ID`)
}

if (length(unique_cancer_types) == 1) {
  data <- subset(data, select = -`Cancer Type`)
}

if (length(unique_study_ids) == 1) {
  data <- subset(data, select = -`Study ID`)
}

if (length(unique_sample_types) == 1) {
  data <- subset(data, select = -`Sample Type`)
}

if (length(unique_numbers_of_samples_per_patient) == 1) {
  data <- subset(data, select = -`Number of Samples Per Patient`)
}

# suppressing the sex variable
data <- subset(data, select = -`Sex`)

# suppressing the ER status
data <- subset(data, select = -`ER Status`)

```

```{r}
df <- as.data.frame(data)
```


### data overview

```{r}
cat("Dataset dimensions:", nrow(df), "rows x", ncol(df), "columns\n\n")

# Missing values summary
missing_summary <- data.frame(
  Variable = names(df),
  Missing_Count = colSums(is.na(df)),
  Missing_Percent = round(colSums(is.na(df)) / nrow(df) * 100, 2)
) %>% filter(Missing_Count > 0)

print(missing_summary)
```

### DEFINE VARIABLE TYPES

```{r}
continuous_vars <- c(
  "Age at Diagnosis", "Lymph nodes examined positive", "Mutation Count",
  "Nottingham prognostic index", "Overall Survival (Months)",
  "Relapse Free Status (Months)", "TMB (nonsynonymous)", "Tumor Size"
)

categorical_vars <- c(
  "Type of Breast Surgery", "Chemotherapy", "ER status measured by IHC",
  "HER2 Status", "Hormone Therapy", "Inferred Menopausal State",
  "PR Status", "Radio Therapy", "Tumor Stage"
)
```

### UNIVARIATE ANALYSIS

```{r}
# Continuous variables: histograms + boxplots
for (var in continuous_vars) {
  if (var %in% names(df)) {
    # Histogram with density
    p1 <- ggplot(df, aes(x = .data[[var]])) +
      geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.7) +
      geom_density(aes(y = after_stat(count)), color = "red", linewidth = 1) +
      theme_minimal() +
      labs(title = paste("Distribution:", var))
    
    # Boxplot
    p2 <- ggplot(df, aes(y = .data[[var]])) +
      geom_boxplot(fill = "lightblue", outlier.color = "red") +
      theme_minimal() +
      labs(title = paste("Boxplot:", var))
    
    print(grid.arrange(p1, p2, ncol = 2))
  }
}

# Categorical variables: bar charts
for (var in categorical_vars) {
  if (var %in% names(df)) {
    p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = .data[[var]])) +
      geom_bar(fill = "coral") +
      geom_text(stat = 'count', aes(label = after_stat(count)), vjust = -0.5) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
      labs(title = paste("Distribution:", var))
    print(p)
  }
}
```

### BIVARIATE ANALYSIS

```{r}
# Function to create boxplots for continuous vs categorical
plot_bivariate <- function(cat_var, cont_var, data) {
  if (cat_var %in% names(data) & cont_var %in% names(data)) {
    ggplot(data, aes(x = .data[[cat_var]], y = .data[[cont_var]])) +
      geom_boxplot(fill = "lightgreen", alpha = 0.6) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
      labs(title = paste(cont_var, "by", cat_var))
  }
}

# Key bivariate relationships
key_pairs <- list(
  c("Type of Breast Surgery", "Tumor Size"),
  c("ER status measured by IHC", "Overall Survival (Months)"),
  c("Chemotherapy", "Overall Survival (Months)"),
  c("Tumor Stage", "Age at Diagnosis")
)

for (pair in key_pairs) {
  p <- plot_bivariate(pair[1], pair[2], df)
  if (!is.null(p)) print(p)
}
```

### CORRELATION ANALYSIS

```{r}
#Select numeric variables and create dummies for categorical
numeric_vars <- c("Age at Diagnosis", "Neoplasm Histologic Grade",
                  "Lymph nodes examined positive", "Mutation Count",
                  "Nottingham prognostic index", "Overall Survival (Months)",
                  "Tumor Size", "Tumor Stage")

# Prepare data with complete cases
df_corr <- df %>%
  select(all_of(c(numeric_vars, categorical_vars))) %>%
  filter(complete.cases(.))

# Create dummy variables
df_dummies <- df_corr
for (var in categorical_vars) {
  if (var %in% names(df_dummies)) {
    formula_str <- as.formula(paste0("~ `", var, "` - 1"))
    dummies <- model.matrix(formula_str, data = df_dummies)
    colnames(dummies) <- gsub("`", "", colnames(dummies))
    colnames(dummies) <- gsub(var, paste0(var, "_"), colnames(dummies), fixed = TRUE)
    df_dummies <- cbind(df_dummies, dummies)
    df_dummies[[var]] <- NULL
  }
}

# Correlation matrix
cor_matrix <- cor(df_dummies, use = "complete.obs")

# Plot full correlation matrix
corrplot(cor_matrix, method = "color", type = "upper", 
         tl.cex = 0.5, tl.col = "black",
         title = "Correlation Matrix - All Variables",
         mar = c(0, 0, 2, 0))

# Focus on continuous variables
continuous_in_data <- intersect(numeric_vars, names(df_dummies))
cor_matrix_cont <- cor(df_dummies[, continuous_in_data])

corrplot(cor_matrix_cont, method = "circle", type = "upper",
         addCoef.col = "black", number.cex = 0.7,
         tl.col = "black", tl.srt = 45,
         title = "Correlation Matrix - Continuous Variables",
         mar = c(0, 0, 2, 0))

# Pairwise scatterplots for key variables
key_vars <- c("Age at Diagnosis", "Tumor Size", "Overall Survival (Months)",
              "Nottingham prognostic index")
key_vars <- intersect(key_vars, names(df))

if (length(key_vars) > 1) {
  ggpairs(df[, key_vars], title = "Pairwise Relationships")
}
```

### KAPLAN-MEIER SURVIVAL CURVES

```{r}
# Prepare survival data
df_surv <- df %>%
  mutate(
    os_event = ifelse(grepl("1:|DECEASED|Died", `Overall Survival Status`), 1, 0),
    rfs_event = ifelse(grepl("1:|Recurred", `Relapse Free Status`), 1, 0)
  )

# Function to create and plot KM curves
plot_km <- function(time_var, event_var, group_var, data, title_prefix = "Survival") {
  df_temp <- data %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[group_var]]), !is.na(.data[[time_var]]), !is.na(.data[[event_var]]))
  
  if (nrow(df_temp) < 10) return(NULL)
  
  # Create a simple dataframe with renamed columns for survfit
  surv_data <- data.frame(
    time = df_temp[[time_var]],
    event = df_temp[[event_var]],
    group = factor(df_temp[[group_var]])
  )
  
  # Fit KM model
  km_fit <- survfit(Surv(time, event) ~ group, data = surv_data)
  
  ggsurvplot(
    km_fit, data = surv_data,
    title = paste(title_prefix, "by", group_var),
    pval = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE,
    risk.table = TRUE, risk.table.height = 0.25,
    legend.title = group_var,
    legend.labs = levels(surv_data$group),
    palette = "jco",
    ggtheme = theme_minimal()
  )
}

# Overall Survival curves for all categorical variables
cat("\n=== Overall Survival Curves ===\n")
for (var in categorical_vars) {
  if (var %in% names(df_surv)) {
    p <- plot_km("Overall Survival (Months)", "os_event", var, df_surv, "Overall Survival")
    if (!is.null(p)) print(p)
  }
}

# Relapse-Free Survival curves for key variables
cat("\n=== Relapse-Free Survival Curves ===\n")
key_rfs_vars <- c("Chemotherapy", "ER status measured by IHC", "HER2 Status", "Tumor Stage", "Cellularity")
for (var in key_rfs_vars) {
  if (var %in% names(df_surv)) {
    p <- plot_km("Relapse Free Status (Months)", "rfs_event", var, df_surv, "Relapse-Free Survival")
    if (!is.null(p)) print(p)
  }
}
```
```{r}
# Prepare survival data
df_surv <- df %>%
  mutate(
    os_event = ifelse(grepl("1:|DECEASED|Died", `Overall Survival Status`), 1, 0),
    rfs_event = ifelse(grepl("1:|Recurred", `Relapse Free Status`), 1, 0)
  )

# Function to create and plot KM curves
plot_km <- function(time_var, event_var, group_var, data, title_prefix = "Survival") {
  df_temp <- data %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[group_var]]), !is.na(.data[[time_var]]), !is.na(.data[[event_var]]))
  
  if (nrow(df_temp) < 10) return(NULL)
  
  # Create a simple dataframe with renamed columns for survfit
  surv_data <- data.frame(
    time = df_temp[[time_var]],
    event = df_temp[[event_var]],
    group = factor(df_temp[[group_var]])
  )
  
  # Fit KM model
  km_fit <- survfit(Surv(time, event) ~ group, data = surv_data)
  
  ggsurvplot(
    km_fit, data = surv_data,
    title = paste(title_prefix, "by", group_var),
    pval = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE,
    risk.table = TRUE, risk.table.height = 0.25,
    legend.title = group_var,
    legend.labs = levels(surv_data$group),
    palette = "jco",
    ggtheme = theme_minimal()
  )
}

# Function to perform log-rank test and return results
perform_logrank_test <- function(time_var, event_var, group_var, data) {
  df_temp <- data %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[group_var]]), !is.na(.data[[time_var]]), !is.na(.data[[event_var]]))
  
  if (nrow(df_temp) < 10 || length(unique(df_temp[[group_var]])) < 2) {
    return(data.frame(
      Variable = group_var,
      N = nrow(df_temp),
      N_Groups = length(unique(df_temp[[group_var]])),
      Chi_Square = NA,
      DF = NA,
      P_Value = NA,
      Significance = "Not enough data"
    ))
  }
  
  # Create survival object
  surv_data <- data.frame(
    time = df_temp[[time_var]],
    event = df_temp[[event_var]],
    group = factor(df_temp[[group_var]])
  )
  
  # Perform log-rank test
  logrank_test <- survdiff(Surv(time, event) ~ group, data = surv_data)
  
  # Extract p-value
  p_value <- 1 - pchisq(logrank_test$chisq, length(logrank_test$n) - 1)
  
  # Determine significance
  sig_level <- ifelse(p_value < 0.001, "***",
                      ifelse(p_value < 0.01, "**",
                             ifelse(p_value < 0.05, "*", "NS")))
  
  return(data.frame(
    Variable = group_var,
    N = nrow(df_temp),
    N_Groups = length(unique(df_temp[[group_var]])),
    Chi_Square = round(logrank_test$chisq, 3),
    DF = length(logrank_test$n) - 1,
    P_Value = formatC(p_value, format = "e", digits = 3),
    Significance = sig_level
  ))
}

# Overall Survival: Test results summary
cat("\n", rep("=", 80), "\n")
cat("OVERALL SURVIVAL - LOG-RANK TEST RESULTS\n")
cat(rep("=", 80), "\n")

os_test_results <- data.frame()
for (var in categorical_vars) {
  if (var %in% names(df_surv)) {
    test_result <- perform_logrank_test("Overall Survival (Months)", "os_event", var, df_surv)
    os_test_results <- rbind(os_test_results, test_result)
  }
}

print(os_test_results, row.names = FALSE)
cat("\nSignificance codes: *** p<0.001, ** p<0.01, * p<0.05, NS = not significant\n\n")

# Overall Survival curves for significant variables
cat("\n=== Overall Survival Curves (All Variables) ===\n")
for (var in categorical_vars) {
  if (var %in% names(df_surv)) {
    p <- plot_km("Overall Survival (Months)", "os_event", var, df_surv, "Overall Survival")
    if (!is.null(p)) print(p)
  }
}

# Relapse-Free Survival: Test results summary
cat("\n", rep("=", 80), "\n")
cat("RELAPSE-FREE SURVIVAL - LOG-RANK TEST RESULTS\n")
cat(rep("=", 80), "\n")

rfs_test_results <- data.frame()
for (var in categorical_vars) {
  if (var %in% names(df_surv)) {
    test_result <- perform_logrank_test("Relapse Free Status (Months)", "rfs_event", var, df_surv)
    rfs_test_results <- rbind(rfs_test_results, test_result)
  }
}

print(rfs_test_results, row.names = FALSE)
cat("\nSignificance codes: *** p<0.001, ** p<0.01, * p<0.05, NS = not significant\n\n")

# Relapse-Free Survival curves for significant variables
cat("\n=== Relapse-Free Survival Curves (Key Variables) ===\n")
key_rfs_vars <- c("Chemotherapy", "ER status measured by IHC", "HER2 Status", "Tumor Stage")
for (var in key_rfs_vars) {
  if (var %in% names(df_surv)) {
    p <- plot_km("Relapse Free Status (Months)", "rfs_event", var, df_surv, "Relapse-Free Survival")
    if (!is.null(p)) print(p)
  }
}

# Create comparison table of significant variables
cat("\n", rep("=", 80), "\n")
cat("SUMMARY: VARIABLES WITH SIGNIFICANT SURVIVAL DIFFERENCES\n")
cat(rep("=", 80), "\n")

significant_os <- os_test_results %>%
  filter(Significance != "NS" & Significance != "Not enough data") %>%
  arrange(Chi_Square) %>%
  select(Variable, P_Value, Significance)

significant_rfs <- rfs_test_results %>%
  filter(Significance != "NS" & Significance != "Not enough data") %>%
  arrange(Chi_Square) %>%
  select(Variable, P_Value, Significance)

cat("\nSignificant for Overall Survival:\n")
if (nrow(significant_os) > 0) {
  print(significant_os, row.names = FALSE)
} else {
  cat("No significant variables found.\n")
}

cat("\nSignificant for Relapse-Free Survival:\n")
if (nrow(significant_rfs) > 0) {
  print(significant_rfs, row.names = FALSE)
} else {
  cat("No significant variables found.\n")
}
```
